positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
Apache Web Server Security Study:

Collaboration: Played a key role in a pioneering research study investigating security vulnerabilities in the Apache Web Server, covering a span of 17 years.
Analysis & Findings: Conducted both quantitative and qualitative analyses of 124 Vulnerability-Contributing Commits, identifying critical patterns and insights. Our research focused on pinpointing what indicators could have alerted developers to potential security concerns within these commits.
Publication: Co-authored a paper published in the Proceedings of the 2013 ACM-IEEE International Symposium on Empirical Software Engineering and Measurement, titled "When a patch goes bad: Exploring the properties of vulnerability-contributing commits". This work contributes significantly to understanding the nature of security vulnerabilities in software development.

-
Google Chrome Security Research:

Collaboration: Contributed to extensive research on security vulnerabilities in Google Chrome, examining a vast dataset from the Chromium project.
Data Analysis: Analyzed 159,254 code reviews, 185,948 Git commits, and 667 post-release vulnerabilities, employing a comprehensive approach to understand the correlation between socio-technical factors and security vulnerabilities.
Publication: Contributed to a paper for the Workshop on Social Software Engineering at the International Conference on Foundations in Software Engineering 2014, titled "An Empirical Investigation of Socio-Technical Code Review Metrics and Security Vulnerabilities". This publication sheds light on the impact of code review practices on software security.

positions.title: Software Engineer, Team Lead
positions.description:
- Spearheaded agile software engineering team efforts in the banking, pharmaceutical, and government sectors, focusing on project alignment and cross-functional collaboration.
- Delivered scalable and secure software solutions, emphasizing robust security measures and system scalability to handle increasing demands.
- Led the development and integration of APIs, enhancing software interoperability across complex, multi-platform environments.
- Proficient in C#, Java, .NET, JavaScript, SQL, and other languages, applying these technologies to create high-quality, maintainable, and efficient software systems.
- Implemented advanced DevOps and Continuous Integration/Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) practices, significantly improving development lifecycle efficiency and software release quality.
- Contributed to optimizing software processes, ensuring high efficiency and productivity in software development and deployment workflows.
- Championed software engineering best practices, integrating highly resilient services architecture and automated testing to enhance team agility and product quality.
- Directed strategic software architecture decisions, ensuring system scalability, security, and performance, meeting the high standards of diverse sectors.
